description: Operating system field stored as a short string. All 30 records are non‑null; the column has low cardinality with 8 distinct values. Observed values show inconsistent casing such as 'android' vs 'Android', 'IOS' vs 'iOS', 'LINUX' vs 'Linux', and 'macOs' vs the proper 'macOS'.
